title: Warehouse Management System (WMS)
description: A comprehensive web application for warehouse logistics to track real-time inventory across multiple zones, shelves, and bins. Features inbound/outbound order verification, automated stock alerts, and a normalized PostgreSQL schema to efficiently manage products and internal stock movements.

title: SecureSign (Digital Signature System)
description: A secure full-stack web tool for uploading PDF files, generating digital signatures, and validating document authenticity. Utilizes RSA and ECDSA cryptography for secure key generation and features PostgreSQL JSONB event logging to track user actions and maintain cryptographic audit trails.

title: Fast Food POS System
description: A comprehensive Point of Sale system tailored for fast-food restaurants. Features real-time kitchen order processing, inventory tracking, staff role management, and detailed sales analytics.

title: SmartDoc AI (Local Document RAG)
description: A local Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) tool designed to parse, analyze, and query offline documents. Integrates local Large Language Models via Ollama and FAISS for efficient vector storage and highly accurate text retrieval.

title: SoundWave (Audio Streaming Platform)
description: An audio streaming platform developed using a Monorepo structure, featuring synchronized media playback. Includes a robust relational database designed with Prisma to systematically manage users, music tracks, and public playlists, fully secured by JWT authentication and refresh mechanisms.

title: TechZone E-Commerce
description: A full-stack e-commerce platform dedicated to electronic devices (concept similar to The Gioi Di Dong). Includes advanced product filtering, secure cart management, user authentication, and a robust admin dashboard.

title: Phone Store Management System
description: A desktop-based phone store management system built with Java Swing and MySQL, featuring inventory management, invoicing, warranty tracking, role-based access control, employee management, and business statistics visualization following the MVC architecture.
